tasks.instruction:
W każdą z luk wpisz odpowiednie słowo przekształcając wyraz podany na końcu zdania drukowanymi literami. Wymagana jest pełna poprawność gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych słów.

Przykład: The __________ (SERVE) in this restaurant was absolutely appalling. — prawidłowa odpowiedź: SERVICE

items.sentence: He showed __________ for the warning signs and continued hiking up the mountain despite the approaching storm.
The factory workers complained that their tasks were too __________, doing the same thing over and over again every day.
The results of the experiment were __________ successful, showing no errors in any of the trials.
They've put forward a number of __________ to the problem we're currently facing, but none of them is really satisfactory.
Being __________ wealthy, my uncle can purchase any car he desires.
The __________ spent their first week of marriage exploring a charming seaside town on their honeymoon.
As a __________ person, she often volunteers at the local shelter and regularly donates money to various causes.
The old lady's __________ was evident when she donated a substantial portion of her savings to support the local children's home.
The noise from the construction site was loud, but with earplugs, it was __________ enough to focus on work.
As a child, she spent hours creating adventures with her __________ friend, who always helped her explore new worlds.

tasks.instruction:
Wpisz słowo poprawnie uzupełniające każde ze zdań. Liczba kreseczek odpowiada liczbie liter w słowie. Wymagana jest pełna poprawność gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych słów.

Przykład: She asked for a(n) __ __ e __ __ __ i __ (8) type of flower for her bouquet. — prawidłowa odpowiedź: SPECIFIC

items.sentence: When the device started overheating, he immediately u __ __ l __ __ g __ __ (9) it from the socket to prevent any potential damage.
The criminals threatened to harm the hostages if their demand for a hefty r __ __ __ o __ (6) was not met within 24 hours.
The roller coaster rapidly rushed d __ w __ __ __ r __ __ (9), causing everyone on board to shout with excitement.
The book my teacher recommended turned out to be so t __ __ __ o __ __ (7) that I actually lost count how many times I fell asleep attempting to read it.
The mansion, f __ __ m __ __ l __ (8) owned by a famous artist, is now a popular museum showcasing his work.
During the meeting, I had a sudden f __ a __ __ b __ __ __ (9) to my childhood, remembering how my father used to give similar advice.
The soldiers were instructed to protect the c __ v __ __ __ a __ __ (9) during the conflict, ensuring their safety above all else.
He showed up at the party in a c __ s __ __ __ (6) outfit, wearing jeans and a t-shirt, while everyone else was dressed formally.
The actor's performance on stage was f __ a __ __ __ s __ (8), earning him a standing ovation from the audience.
The heat during the summer was so intense that it became u __ b __ __ __ __ __ l __ (10), driving everyone indoors to seek relief.

tasks.instruction:
Uzupełnij każde ze zdań wyrazami z nawiasów w odpowiedniej formie. Nie wolno zmieniać kolejności słów w nawiasie, natomiast w niektórych przypadkach należy dodać brakujące słowo lub słowa, tak aby zdania były poprawne i logiczne. Wymagana jest pełna poprawność gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych słów. Każde rozwiązanie ma od 3 do 6 słów. Formy skrócone typu: don't, isn't, that's etc. są liczone jako jedno słowo.

Przykład: She __________ (not / see) the film yet. — prawidłowa odpowiedź: hasn't seen

items.context: I have arranged with the shop that my new _________ (furniture / deliver) flat between 6 and 7 p.m. tonight. This way I don't need to take a day-off from work.
items.answer: furniture is being delivered to my

items.context: As I walked through the park, I _________ (see / child / play) joyfully on the swings, laughing at the top of their lungs.
items.answer: could see children playing / saw children playing

items.context: They will consider your application, _________ (provide / you / submit) all the required documents.
items.answer: provided that you submit / providing that you submit / provided you submit / providing you submit

items.context: This is _________ (five / time / I / be) to England and I still can't help being totally amazed by the beauty of this country.
items.answer: the fifth time I have ('ve) been

items.context: Hearing how unfairly my teacher criticized the project I presented yesterday _________ (make / I / think / change) my school.
items.answer: made me think of changing / made me think about changing / made me think I should change

items.context: A boy living next door _________ (rumor / steal) groceries from the corner shop for at least a month. The shop's owner is now determined to catch the suspect red-handed.
items.answer: is rumored to have been stealing / is rumoured to have been stealing

items.context: My sister won't listen to anybody's advice so it _________ (use / try) talk her out of consuming fast food.
If I were you, I would get aunt Betty _________ (organise / Sandra / father-in-law) farewell party because she has amazing organizational skills.
items.answer: to organise Sandra's father-in-law's / to organize Sandra's father-in-law's

items.context: The day Ben started working in the same office as me I realized we _________ (already / bump) each other several times in the local gym.
I'd rather you _________ (bring / girlfriend) to my party. On top of looking totally bored all the time, she had the guts to criticize the food and the music.
items.answer: hadn't brought your girlfriend / had not brought your girlfriend

tasks.instruction: Uzupełnij lukę w każdym ze zdań, wybierając jedną poprawną odpowiedź z zaproponowanych możliwości A) – D).

items.stem: Your clothes are filthy! As soon as you __________ home, throw them all into the laundry.
__________ surprised the teacher the most was the top students' poor performance in the final exams.
Our parents agreed to __________ us repaint the walls of our room if we use neutral colours.
The more she practised speaking in public, __________ she became, until eventually she found herself looking forward to giving presentations.
Despite the heavy traffic, we __________ reach the airport on time.
Citizens under the age of 18 are not __________ to vote in elections.
Marrion had a __________ escape when she had a head-on collision with a truck.
Nancy was happy that she __________ a new mobile phone and was able to save a lot of money as she had won the latest model of the I-phone in a lottery.
__________ details concerning the tournament's opening ceremony __________ so far.
options: A) Only a few / weren't revealed
C) Only a little / haven't been revealed
D) Very few / have been revealed

items.stem: When the president gave his statement he asked if there were any questions. Only one journalist __________ his hand.

tasks.instruction: Odpowiedz na pytania wybierając jedną poprawną odpowiedź z zaproponowanych możliwości A) – D).

items.question: Which of the statements about the Act of Supremacy is false?
options: A. It was passed by the Parliament of England in 1543.
B. The passing of the law marked the beginning of the English Reformation.
C. One of the reasons for its passing was the king's personal interest.
D. It gave the monarch an additional function he had not possessed earlier.

items.question: What actions earned Queen Mary I of England the nickname 'Bloody Mary'?
options: A. She cursed a lot and 'bloody' was her favorite swearword.
B. She enjoyed watching bloody fights between her subjects.
C. She suffered from a disease affecting her blood vessels.
D. She gave an order to persecute Protestant heretics.
